title: Every sliding window shows the same numbers
prompt:
slidingWindows(int[] values, int size) must return a List<List<Integer>> holding every
contiguous window of length size, left to right. When size is 0 or negative, or larger
than values.length, return an empty list.

The row count is always right and a single-window input is always right, but as soon as
there is more than one window every row shows the same numbers. Find the bug and fix it.

Example:
  slidingWindows([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) -> [[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]]

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
